description:
This classic hybrid style cruiser with 26-inch wheels from Firmstrong is perfect for cruise, leisure, and commute riding. Featuring a Shimano 7 Speed Hub, the bike is ideal for street, trail, long distance and uphill riding. The forward pedaling design on the Firmstrong ANYjourney is designed with a low center of gravity that allows for the rider's back to remain upright with proper leg extension while riding. When at a full stop the rider can stand over the seat and easily mount and dismount the bike. The silver components coupled with the Navy Blue frame provide for a sleek, modern looking frame. Front and rear handbrakes make stopping easy and precise. The cruiser’s mechanical configuration, classic frame, and additional features make this an awesome bike for almost any situation – rain or shine, city or cruising

17" Aluminum Frame with 26" Wheels

The foot-forward seat and pedal position allows riders of varying heights to stop and put feet flat on the ground

Shimano 7-speed Hub with front and rear handbrakes

Men's step-through aluminum city frame

1.95” Wide Kenda White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, smooth ride for easy rolling

Bicycle Weighs 35lbs Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’ – 6’3 Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 30mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 30 miles in a single trip

Rear Rack Included
